module: Flowgraph node "Play Sound" (category dynamic_p_duration, dynamic mode 'repeat', tags sound/audio/volume). Plays an audio sample with Engine.Audio.playOnce. Inputs: file (source, default 'event:UI_Checkpoint'), channel (hidden, default 'AudioGui'), and hidden pins volume (default 1), pitch (1), fadeInTime (-1), fadeOutTime (-1), unique (false). In 'repeat' mode, the sound is replayed on every flow frame; otherwise only once.
notes: The file pin also accepts ".prefab.json" files in the editor's picker (leftover from the template, unrelated to audio).
The result of playOnce is stored in a local variable and unused.

postInit.desc: Configures the editor: file filter of the file pin and a 0-1 slider for volume.

work.desc: If dynamicMode is 'repeat', replays the sound every frame.

playSound.desc: Builds the data (volume, pitch, fades, unique, sampleSource, channel) from the pins and calls Engine.Audio.playOnce(channel, source, data).
